SheepBall.name: Lamball
SheepBall.description:
A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down.
This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, 
making it easy to capture and kill.
As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom 
of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

PinkCat.name: Cattiva
PinkCat.description:
At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly.
Being toyed with by a <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>
is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, <characterName id=|PinkCat|/> helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by 100/120/140/160/200. (Does not stack)

ChickenPal.name: Chikipi
ChickenPal.description:
Extremely weak and far too delicious.
It is one of the weakest Pals alongside <characterName id=|SheepBall|/>.
No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch.

Carbunclo.name: Lifmunk
Carbunclo.description:
Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. 
It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases 
where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

BluePlatypus.name: Fuack
BluePlatypus.description:
Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. 
It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends 
in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|BluePlatypus|/> body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

BluePlatypus_Fire.name: Fuack Ignis
BluePlatypus_Fire.description:
With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs.
But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

partnerSkill.name: Fire Tackle
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|BluePlatypus_Fire|/> fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

CuteFox.name: Vixy
CuteFox.description:
The idol of Palpagos Island.
If you bully a <characterName id=|CuteFox|/>,
you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.

FlyingManta.name: Celaray
FlyingManta.description:
Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. 
Should it find a partner along the way, 
the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

FlyingManta_Thunder.name: Celaray Lux
FlyingManta_Thunder.description:
Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner.
But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving <characterName id=|FlyingManta_Thunder|/>,
yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Glider
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

WoolFox.name: Cremis
WoolFox.description:
Compared to <characterName id=|SheepBall|/>, it has finer wool
and a temperament more suited for domestication.
However, it has historically always been kept as a pet.
Cuteness is considered a virtue.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Wool
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

KendoFrog.name: Croajiro
KendoFrog.description:
Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life.
By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch,
they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

partnerSkill.name: Leap Stance
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|KendoFrog_Dark|/> channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne before landing, the player's Attack is increased by 50/56/64/74/86%.

KendoFrog_Dark.name: Croajiro Noct
KendoFrog_Dark.description:
The <characterName id=|KendoFrog|/> who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups.
They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey.
If you encounter a pack of <characterName id=|KendoFrog_Dark|/> in the dead of the night, 
it's your life that's on the line.

partnerSkill.name: Shadow Stance
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|KendoFrog_Dark|/> channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Dark damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

LeafMomonga.name: Herbil
LeafMomonga.description:
When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s <characterName id=|LeafMomonga|/>'s approach to fixing things.
With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

partnerSkill.name: Herbil Pulse
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, <characterName id=|LeafMomonga|/> uses its healing powers to restore 30/36/42/48/60% of the player's Max Health when incapacitated. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

Ganesha.name: Teafant
Ganesha.description:
Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose,
though some say that it is, in fact, just snot.
This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, restores 20/24/28/32/40% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)

PlantSlime.name: Gumoss
PlantSlime.description:
A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. 
It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover 
its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, improves logging efficiency by 30/35/40/45/50% and reduces weight of all types of wood by 40/45/50/55/60%. (Does not stack)

SamuraiDog.name: Pupperai
SamuraiDog.description:
<characterName id=|SamuraiDog|/> territorial disputes begin with a staredown 
and end in a single, quick strike. 
Training them to |stay| is risky business, 
as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.

partnerSkill.name: Best Boy
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by 10/15/20/25/35%. (Does not stack)

CloverFairy.name: Clovee
CloverFairy.description:
Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads.
Regarded as symbols of good fortune, 
those with more leaves were heavily hunted, 
leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

partnerSkill.name: Happy Clover
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

Hedgehog.name: Jolthog
Hedgehog.description:
It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack.
The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts,
making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips <characterName id=|Hedgehog|/> to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Hedgehog_Ice.name: Jolthog Cryst
Hedgehog_Ice.description:
It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. 
The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air 
and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips <characterName id=|Hedgehog_Ice|/> to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

NegativeKoala.name: Depresso
NegativeKoala.description:
It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face,
but it is in fact kindhearted.
Some have seen it feeding <characterName id=|CuteFox|/> who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|NegativeKoala|/> chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by 100/200/400/600/900%. Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.

Penguin.name: Pengullet
Penguin.description:
The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared,
but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever.
Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire <characterName id=|Penguin|/> as ammunition. <characterName id=|Penguin|/> explodes on impact and is incapacitated. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Penguin_Electric.name: Pengullet Lux
Penguin_Electric.description:
The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly.
Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy—
so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Lux Launcher
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, the player equips <characterName id=|Penguin_Electric|/> to fire Rocket Launcher as ammunition. <characterName id=|Penguin_Electric|/> explodes on impact and is incapacitated. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

CaptainPenguin.name: Penking
CaptainPenguin.description:
Surprisingly, it is unrelated to <characterName id=|Penguin|/>.
However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, 
for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, Fire Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

CaptainPenguin_Black.name: Penking Lux
CaptainPenguin_Black.description:
Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting.
As a result, it lost the affection of <characterName id=|Penguin|/>—
but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: <characterName id=|Penguin_Electric|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Water damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

WizardOwl.name: Hoocrates
WizardOwl.description:
Often lost in thought, it sometimes
finds it difficult to sleep.
|I think, therefore I am.|

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knowledge
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

Alpaca.name: Melpaca
Alpaca.description:
Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. 
A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may 
send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases <characterName id=|KingAlpaca|/>'s Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

KingAlpaca.name: Kingpaca
KingAlpaca.description:
<characterName id=|Alpaca|/> serve this Pal.
Contests between <characterName id=|KingAlpaca|/> offer up their vassals as a wager.
Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5/7/9/11/14% for each <characterName id=|Alpaca|/> in party.

KingAlpaca_Ice.name: Kingpaca Cryst
KingAlpaca_Ice.description:
With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions.
A solitary individual is pitiable,
seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a <characterName id=|Alpaca|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Coldhearted King
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5/7/9/11/14% for each <characterName id=|Alpaca|/> in party.

DreamDemon.name: Daedream
DreamDemon.description:
It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them
an endless stream of happy dreams.
Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Monkey.name: Tanzee
Monkey.description:
Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons.
After coming into contact with humans, however,
it found something slightly more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|Monkey|/> will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Monkey_Fire.name: Tanzee Ignis
Monkey_Fire.description:
Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. 
When its gun runs out of ammo,
it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|Monkey_Fire|/> will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

NightFox.name: Nox
NightFox.description:
If you find <characterName id=|NightFox|/> hair in your bedding, you should 
leave it where it lays and leave immediately. 
Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies. (Detection Range Expansion + Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

LavaGirl.name: Flambelle
LavaGirl.description:
When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears.
The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, 
causing it to get hotter and hotter.
The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.1/0.15/0.2/0.3/0.5% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

FlameBambi.name: Rooby
FlameBambi.description:
Wild <characterName id=|FlameBambi|/> surprisingly never get sick.
Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch,
is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Fire Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

Bastet.name: Mau
Bastet.description:
Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off.
Some believed these severed tails bring good luck,
but for the innumerable <characterName id=|Bastet|/> who were
poached as a result, they were anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch.

Bastet_Ice.name: Mau Cryst
Bastet_Ice.description:
Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies.
Some believe it is good luck to raise them,
so <characterName id=|Bastet_Ice|/> in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Whispers
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Iceorgan when assigned to Ranch.

Boar.name: Rushoar
Boar.description:
Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. 
Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by 500/750/1100/1500/2000%.

Kitsunebi.name: Foxparks
Kitsunebi.description:
It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born
and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally.
<characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/> sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Kitsunebi_Ice.name: Foxparks Cryst
Kitsunebi_Ice.description:
It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born
and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. 
When <characterName id=|Kitsunebi_Ice|/> catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, 
making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Frost
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

NegativeOctopus.name: Killamari
NegativeOctopus.description:
It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. 
Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact 
<characterName id=|NegativeOctopus|/> victims.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

NegativeOctopus_Neutral.name: Killamari Primo
NegativeOctopus_Neutral.description:
It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. 
When two <characterName id=|NegativeOctopus_Neutral|/>s latch onto each other, 
they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Killamari
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

CuteMole.name: Fuddler
CuteMole.description:
Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. 
However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, 
leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, improves player mining efficiency by 30/34/40/48/60% and reduces Stone weight by 80/84/88/92/100%. (Does not stack)

Deer.name: Eikthyrdeer
Deer.description:
The one who possesses the most impressive antlers 
becomes the leader of the herd.
If their antlers are broken, they become depressed
and leave the herd never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by 220/260/320/400/500%.

Deer_Ground.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
Deer_Ground.description:
The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader.
Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status.
It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 (Does not stack)

Garm.name: Direhowl
Garm.description:
Long ago <characterName id=|Garm|/> would hunt alongside humans
but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

BerryGoat.name: Caprity
BerryGoat.description:
The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed.
It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores 100/120/140/160/200 Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

BerryGoat_Dark.name: Caprity Noct
BerryGoat_Dark.description:
The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions.
The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become.
This is why most <characterName id=|BerryGoat_Dark|/> raised in captivity have never known love.

partnerSkill.name: Venom Picker
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores 100/120/140/160/200 Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

MopBaby.name: Swee
MopBaby.description:
Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter.
After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition.
By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of <characterName id=|MopKing|/>.

MopKing.name: Sweepa
MopKing.description:
While hibernating, a large number of <characterName id=|MopBaby|/>
hide within its voluminous body hair.
The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 12/13/15/19/24% for each <characterName id=|MopBaby|/> in party.

TentacleTurtle.name: Turtacle
TentacleTurtle.description:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. 
Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. 
Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces Ore weight by 80/84/88/92/100%. (Does not stack)

TentacleTurtle_Ground.name: Turtacle Terra
TentacleTurtle_Ground.description:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. 
With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, 
it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.

partnerSkill.name: Shiny Hauler
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal by 80/84/88/92/100%. Also improves player's and Pals' Ground damage to enemy weak points by 80/84/88/92/100%. (Does not stack)

WindChimes.name: Hangyu
WindChimes.description:
Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron.
As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals
would be strung up in a public square, and a <characterName id=|Windchimes|/>
would tear the skin right from their bones.

partnerSkill.name: Flying Trapeze
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

WindChimes_Ice.name: Hangyu Cryst
WindChimes_Ice.description:
Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice.
There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square
and had their hair torn out by <characterName id=|Windchimes_Ice|/>
as a brutal form of public humiliation.

partnerSkill.name: Winter Trapeze
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

SweetsSheep.name: Woolipop
SweetsSheep.description:
Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar.
Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves 
overwhelmed by sweetness
and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10/-12/-14/-16/-20%. (Does not stack)

SweetsSheep_Ground.name: Woolipop Terra
SweetsSheep_Ground.description:
Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. 
Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -15/-17/-19/-21/-25%. (Does not stack)

CowPal.name: Mozzarina
CowPal.description:
Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, 
regardless of its gender.
It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.desc: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch.

BlueDragon.name: Azurobe
BlueDragon.description:
This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. 
Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. 
This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

BlueDragon_Ice.name: Azurobe Cryst
BlueDragon_Ice.description:
This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, 
yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. 
This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, 
leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Icewing Dance
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

ElecCat.name: Sparkit
ElecCat.description:
During the dry season,
this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse.
Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation,
even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Electric Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.

Kelpie.name: Kelpsea
Kelpie.description:
Its personality changes depending 
on the quality of the water it was born into.
<characterName id=|Kelpie|/> born into polluted waters are generally 
ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.

Kelpie_Fire.name: Kelpsea Ignis
Kelpie_Fire.description:
Its personality changes depending 
on the temperature of the water it was born into.
<characterName id=|Kelpie|/> born in warm waters generally have 
a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Fire Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

PinkRabbit.name: Ribbuny
PinkRabbit.description:
A Pal that's never without a bright smile.
Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>'s pranks.
During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

PinkRabbit_Grass.name: Ribbuny Botan
PinkRabbit_Grass.description:
Always wears a cheerful smile.
Sometimes, thanks to <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>'s pranks, 
they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out!
Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

partnerSkill.name: Ground 'n' Pound
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Grass damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack) Increases efficiency by 200/220/260/320/400% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.

JellyfishFairy.name: Jelliette
JellyfishFairy.description:
A Pal that closely resembles <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/>.
It’s very social, so when plans overlap, 
it asks its good friend <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/> to go in its place.
As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by 55/65/75/85/95%. While <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/> and <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/> are in your base, <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/>'s watering speed increases by 50/60/70/90/120%. (Does not stack)

JellyfishGhost.name: Jellroy
JellyfishGhost.description:
A Pal that closely resembles <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/>.
It sometimes appears as a substitute when <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/> is unavailable.
Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

partnerSkill.name: Jellroy Drop
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by 55/65/75/85/95%. While <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/> and <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/> are in your base, <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/>'s watering speed increases by 50/60/70/90/120%. (Does not stack)

ClioneTwins.name: Amione
ClioneTwins.description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For <characterName id=|ClioneTwins|/>, companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

OctopusGirl.name: Gloopie
OctopusGirl.description:
Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal.
Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys.
One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some 
truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the capture gauge decreases 12/17/22/28/35% more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)

OctopusGirl_Neutral.name: Gloopie Primo
OctopusGirl_Neutral.description:
Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal.
Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks.
One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some 
truly unnecessary concern.

partnerSkill.name: Cephalo-Princess
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Water Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

Eagle.name: Galeclaw
Eagle.description:
A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. 
It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, 
which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand. (Glider Performance Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

GhostBlackCat.name: Wispaw
GhostBlackCat.description:
The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans 
who have raised its kind.
Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on <characterName id=|GhostBlackCat|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Death-Cheating Feline
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus. (Does not stack) (Capture Rate Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

HawkBird.name: Nitewing
HawkBird.description:
It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them 
as a surrogate parent. 
Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

CatBat.name: Tombat
CatBat.description:
Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. 
Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, 
the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap. (Detection Range Expansion + Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

ColorfulBird.name: Tocotoco
ColorfulBird.description:
A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. 
It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, 
but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Kirin.name: Univolt
Kirin.description:
It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, 
and thus was not hunted by people.
However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike,
its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Electric damage to weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

Kirin_Ice.name: Univolt Cryst
Kirin_Ice.description:
It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, 
and thus was not hunted by people. 
However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, 
its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Frigid Deity
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

SharkKid.name: Gobfin
SharkKid.description:
Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal.
However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land.
Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller
and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Aqua Gun. When this Pal uses Aqua Gun, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by 10/11/13/16/20%.

SharkKid_Fire.name: Gobfin Ignis
SharkKid_Fire.description:
Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal.
However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land.
Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power 
to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Spirit Fire. When this Pal uses Spirit Fire, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by 10/11/13/16/20%.

Werewolf.name: Loupmoon
Werewolf.description:
The horns on its head grow under the moonlight.
It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns
itch when sunlight hits them.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw. When this Pal uses Jumping Claw, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

Werewolf_Ice.name: Loupmoon Cryst
Werewolf_Ice.description:
The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts.
Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite,
but both the one who tries it and <characterName id=|Werewolf_Ice|/> end up with a headache.

partnerSkill.name: Frozen Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw. When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

DarkCrow.name: Cawgnito
DarkCrow.description:
Long ago it freely soared the skies. 
After losing a contest with <characterName id=|Eagle|/>, it abandoned the skies, 
and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Eerie Nightstreaker
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.

FlameBuffalo.name: Arsox
FlameBuffalo.description:
In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly.
The absurd fury in the cries of <characterName id=|FlameBuffalo|/> transformed into a raging inferno,
which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Cold Resistance +2. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

FluffyBird.name: Muffly
FluffyBird.description:
Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, 
but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, 
leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Flutterer
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack) (Capture Rate Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

LittleBriarRose.name: Bristla
LittleBriarRose.description:
This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous.
It is friendly with <characterName id=|CuteButterfly|/> and only smiles
while a <characterName id=|CuteButterfly|/> is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Grass Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

CuteButterfly.name: Cinnamoth
CuteButterfly.description:
Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. 
There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, 
but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, 
putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog. While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

ElecPomeranian.name: Puffolt
ElecPomeranian.description:
Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked.
Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, 
making bath time together a serious gamble.

partnerSkill.name: Crackle Booster
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

FairyDragon.name: Elphidran
FairyDragon.description:
It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests.
Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil,
often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, Dark Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

FairyDragon_Water.name: Elphidran Aqua
FairyDragon_Water.description:
It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests.
Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions
and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)

BirdDragon.name: Vanwyrm
BirdDragon.description:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a <characterName id=|BirdDragon|/>
are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 20/22/26/32/40%. (Does not stack)

BirdDragon_Ice.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
BirdDragon_Ice.description:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a <characterName id=|BirdDragon_Ice|/> 
are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30/32/36/42/50%. (Does not stack)

CatVampire.name: Felbat
CatVampire.description:
Attacking from the shadows,
this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings.
It's probably best not to know what happens within them,
or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

partnerSkill.name: Life Steal
partnerSkill.desc: While fighting together, grants the player and <characterName id=|CatVampire|/> a life steal effect that restores 5/6/7/8/9% of damage dealt as Health.

VioletFairy.name: Vaelet
VioletFairy.description:
The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers.
A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle.
Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared.
- From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.|

partnerSkill.name: Purification of Gaia
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, Ground Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops various seeds when assigned to Ranch.

SoldierBee.name: Beegarde
SoldierBee.description:
A servant that pledges loyalty to <characterName id=|QueenBee|/>. 
Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. 
It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases <characterName id=|QueenBee|/>'s Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.

QueenBee.name: Elizabee
QueenBee.description:
A chosen queen to rule over <characterName id=|SoldierBee|/>s. 
There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death 
for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.desc: This Pal's Attack increases by 12/13/15/19/24% for each <characterName id=|SoldierBee|/> in party.

PinkLizard.name: Lovander
PinkLizard.description:
Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around.
At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years
even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.desc: While fighting together, grants the player and <characterName id=|PinkLizard|/> a life steal effect that restores 5/6/7/8/9% of damage dealt as Health.

NaughtyCat.name: Grintale
NaughtyCat.description:
<characterName id=|NaughtyCat|/>'s eyes light up the moment
anyone enters its territory.
This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a 50/55/60/65/75% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

PurpleSpider.name: Tarantriss
PurpleSpider.description:
Extremely sticky and clingy.
The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes.
Such is its |personality.|

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

IceSeal.name: Polapup
IceSeal.description:
Among <characterName id=|IceSeal|/>s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect.
Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky—
a common sight during territorial season.
Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying <characterName id=|IceSeal|/>s.

partnerSkill.name: Rider of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 80/100/120/140/160% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes.

IceSeal_Ground.name: Polapup Terra
IceSeal_Ground.description:
Among <characterName id=|IceSeal_Ground|/>s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. 
Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow—
a common sight during particularly competitive seasons.
Traffic forecast: heavy <characterName id=|IceSeal_Ground|/> congestion.

partnerSkill.name: Snowy Mountain Slider
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 80/100/120/140/160% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.

LizardMan.name: Leezpunk
LizardMan.description:
A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance.
Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror
it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|LizardMan|/> and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for 10/12/14/16/20 seconds. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

LizardMan_Fire.name: Leezpunk Ignis
LizardMan_Fire.description:
A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture.
Always in search of the hottest pose,
this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|LizardMan_Fire|/> and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for 10/12/14/16/20 seconds. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

Gorilla.name: Gorirat
Gorilla.description:
It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. 
The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction 
between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases <characterName id=|Gorilla|/>'s Attack by 75/115/165/225/300% for a limited time.

Gorilla_Ground.name: Gorirat Terra
Gorilla_Ground.description:
It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades.
Stronger than <characterName id=|Gorilla|/>, if every <characterName id=|Gorilla_Ground|/>
hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Pound
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's climbing speed by 50/60/70/85/100%. (Does not stack)

Serpent.name: Surfent
Serpent.description:
Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water.
Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

Serpent_Ground.name: Surfent Terra
Serpent_Ground.description:
Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand.
Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Muddy 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

RobinHood.name: Robinquill
RobinHood.description:
A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests.
It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are
and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's bow damage by 10/15/20/25/35%. (Does not stack)

RobinHood_Ground.name: Robinquill Terra
RobinHood_Ground.description:
A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas.
When <characterName id=|RobinHood_Ground|/> bones are found in ruins,
there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Master Archer
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's bow charge speed by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

FlowerRabbit.name: Flopie
FlowerRabbit.description:
It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, 
but hay fever has apparently become a problem for 
<characterName id=|FlowerRabbit|/> as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items. (Item Collection Range Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

FoxMage.name: Wixen
FoxMage.description:
With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena.
It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards <characterName id=|CatMage|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|FoxMage|/> changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

FoxMage_Dark.name: Wixen Noct
FoxMage_Dark.description:
Due to its upbringing, 
it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough.
This Pal stopped worrying about those details,
and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. 
Not on good terms with <characterName id=|CatMage_Fire|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Black Fox Lord
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|FoxMage_Dark|/> changes the player's attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

CatMage.name: Katress
CatMage.description:
With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena.
It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards <characterName id=|FoxMage|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Mystical Black Magic
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, Neutral Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. Also has a 10/15/20/30/50% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)

CatMage_Fire.name: Katress Ignis
CatMage_Fire.description:
Due to its upbringing, 
it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. 
This Pal stopped worrying about those details,
and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. 
Not on good terms with <characterName id=|FoxMage_Dark|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black Magic
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Kindling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

HadesBird.name: Helzephyr
HadesBird.description:
It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell.
Those who dies from <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>'s lightning
are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Death
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

HadesBird_Electric.name: Helzephyr Lux
HadesBird_Electric.description:
It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell.
While considered a subspecies of <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>,
there's a theory that suggests <characterName id=|HadesBird_Electric|/>, struck by lightning from hell,
will transform into <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Thunder
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

GrassMinotaur.name: Elgrove
GrassMinotaur.description:
The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled.
When the leaf falls on its own, <characterName id=|GrassMinotaur|/> accepts its time has come.

partnerSkill.name: Mother Nature's Menace
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|GrassMinotaur|/> changes the player's attack type to Grass and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

GrassMinotaur_Ice.name: Elgrove Cryst
GrassMinotaur_Ice.description:
Its frozen horn stays solid through its life.
When water begins to drip from this ice,
<characterName id=|GrassMinotaur_Ice|/> feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

partnerSkill.name: Father Winter's Threat
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, grants the player the ability to Freeze enemies afflicted with Soak in one strike.

Mutant.name: Lunaris
Mutant.description:
It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes.
Those seen with a <characterName id=|Mutant|/> are in its mind,
simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300/339/399/480/600. (Does not stack)

FengyunDeeper.name: Fenglope
FengyunDeeper.description:
In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings.
As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were
often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

FengyunDeeper_Electric.name: Fenglope Lux
FengyunDeeper_Electric.description:
In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of <characterName id=|FengyunDeeper_Electric|/> 
would result in being struck down by lightning. 
As time passes, artworks depicting <characterName id=|FengyunDeeper_Electric|/> became revered as 
charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

partnerSkill.name: Stormcloud
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While in party, Water Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

FlowerDinosaur.name: Dinossom
FlowerDinosaur.description:
A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. 
It rages on and on like an inferno. 
The phrase |step on a <characterName id=|FlowerDinosaur|/>'s tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increase Defense of Dragon Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

FlowerDinosaur_Electric.name: Dinossom Lux
FlowerDinosaur_Electric.description:
Though struck by lightning, it lives on.
The phrase |struck by a <characterName id=|FlowerDinosaur_Electric|/>'s bolt| has come to mean
narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Defense of Electric Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

Ronin.name: Bushi
Ronin.description:
Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation.
If someone other than a <characterName id=|Ronin|/> wields this blade, the soul within
torments them until they are driven mad.

partnerSkill.name: Brandish Blade
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri. When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier.

Ronin_Dark.name: Bushi Noct
Ronin_Dark.description:
Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation.
If the <characterName id=|Ronin|/> who inherits it has a weak heart, 
the voices of the dead will drive it mad.
The madness turns it into <characterName id=|Ronin_Dark|/> that endlessly wanders.

partnerSkill.name: Void Blade
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri. When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30/35/42/51/65% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)

IceCrocodile.name: Munchill
IceCrocodile.description:
The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, 
making it a natural fridge when closed. 
Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. 
Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans—
whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Maw
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces the weight of ingredient and food by 30/35/40/50/60%. When paired with another Ice Pal, their Rot Speed also reduces by -30/-42/-54/-66/-80%. (Does not stack)

GrassMammoth.name: Mammorest
GrassMammoth.description:
The vegetation on its back varies between individuals.
There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal,
and there are even <characterName id=|GrassMammoth|/> pruning specialists.

partnerSkill.name: Gaia Crusher
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220/260/320/400/500% and mining efficiency by 500/750/1100/1500/2000%.

GrassMammoth_Ice.name: Mammorest Cryst
GrassMammoth_Ice.description:
The vegetation on its back varies between individuals.
There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found
still frozen on the back of a <characterName id=|GrassMammoth_Ice|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Crusher
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220/260/320/400/500% and mining efficiency by 500/750/1100/1500/2000%.

StuffedShark.name: Finsider
StuffedShark.description:
It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, 
but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. 
In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. 
Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

partnerSkill.name: Water Gun
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|StuffedShark|/> changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

StuffedShark_Fire.name: Finsider Ignis
StuffedShark_Fire.description:
Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going.
Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher 
tried climbing in like a sleeping bag.
But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... 
it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

partnerSkill.name: Ember Chamber
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, <characterName id=|StuffedShark_Fire|/> helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory by 60/70/80/90/100%. Also improves player's and Pals' Fire damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

FlowerDoll.name: Petallia
FlowerDoll.description:
A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. 
Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms 
and a new <characterName id=|FlowerDoll|/> is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 75/77/79/82/85%. While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

FlowerDoll_Fire.name: Petallia Ignis
FlowerDoll_Fire.description:
A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. 
The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, 
allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

partnerSkill.name: Passion of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 80/82/84/86/90%. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Grass damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

PandaGirl.name: Leafan
PandaGirl.description:
To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline:
Daily training is the only way!

Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable!
Daily discipline is the only way!

The time has come! Shoot my shot!
Instant rejection, that’s all there is!

The techniques of love were never passed down...
Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

partnerSkill.name: Selfless Discipline
partnerSkill.desc: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 2/3/4/5/6% for each other Grass Pal in your party.

Baphomet.name: Incineram
Baphomet.description:
In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory.
What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

partnerSkill.name: Flameclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Hellfire Claw. When this Pal uses Hellfire Claw, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier.

Baphomet_Dark.name: Incineram Noct
Baphomet_Dark.description:
It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain.
One can only imagine the profound despair
of a parent whose child has been taken away.

partnerSkill.name: Darkclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Nightmare Claw. When this Pal uses Nightmare Claw, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier.

RaijinDaughter.name: Dazzi
RaijinDaughter.description:
Often kind to lonely Pals.
However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship,
it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Electric bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1. (Follow-Up Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

RaijinDaughter_Water.name: Dazzi Noct
RaijinDaughter_Water.description:
Often kind to lonely Pals, 
it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down.
Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Dark Lightning
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1. (Follow-Up Boost: -/S/M/L/XL)

FireKirin.name: Pyrin
FireKirin.description:
Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator,
gifting it with astounding stamina.
If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

FireKirin_Dark.name: Pyrin Noct
FireKirin_Dark.description:
It burns mysterious dark matter as energy
and expels the remaining particles from its body.
If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type toDark and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

LazyDragon.name: Relaxaurus
LazyDragon.description:
Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious.
It perceives everything in its sight as prey
and will stop at nothing to devour it.

partnerSkill.name: Hungry Missile
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

LazyDragon_Electric.name: Relaxaurus Lux
LazyDragon_Electric.description:
One day, <characterName id=|LazyDragon|/> had an idea.
Maybe it was about time for a change.
Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

partnerSkill.name: Missile Party
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

IceFox.name: Foxcicle
IceFox.description:
On nights when the aurora is visible,
it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song.
This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Ice Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.

ThunderBird.name: Beakon
ThunderBird.description:
Some think it is a related species to <characterName id=|RedArmorBird|/>, 
but there is in fact no connection.
Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion
that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>)

ThunderBird_Ice.name: Beakon Cryst
ThunderBird_Ice.description:
Perfectly adapted to colder environments, 
it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form.
Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, 
as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.

partnerSkill.name: Coldsnap
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|ThunderBird_Ice|/>)

GhostAnglerfish.name: Ghangler
GhostAnglerfish.description:
With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness.
The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape 
once spotted by <characterName id=|GhostAnglerFish|/>.
No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home 
safe and sound.

partnerSkill.name: Master of Darkness
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Dark or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|GhostAnglerfish|/>)

GhostAnglerfish_Fire.name: Ghangler Ignis
GhostAnglerfish_Fire.description:
Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey.
Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once 
<characterName id=|GhostAnglerfish_Fire|/> sets its sights on them.
In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

partnerSkill.name: Abyssal Celebrity Chef
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Fire or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|GhostAnglerfish_Fire|/>)

ThunderDog.name: Rayhound
ThunderDog.description:
At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning.
When two <characterName id=|ThunderDog|/>s collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.

partnerSkill.name: Lightning Shepherd
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|ThunderDog|/>)

ThunderDog_Ice.name: Rayhound Cryst
ThunderDog_Ice.description:
Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard,
leading to constant <characterName id=|ThunderDog_Ice|/> collisions due to zero visibility.

partnerSkill.name: Snow Shepherd
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

DarkScorpion.name: Menasting
DarkScorpion.description:
Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow.
This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them.
Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, player's Defense increases by 5/6/7/8/10%, and Electric Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

DarkScorpion_Ground.name: Menasting Terra
DarkScorpion_Ground.description:
Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow.
It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass.
Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Scorpion
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, player's Defense increases by 5/6/7/8/10%, and Electric Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

CactusDoll.name: Needoll
CactusDoll.description:
Its spikes react to its emotions.
A dearly cherished <characterName id=|CactusDoll|/> is something one may instinctively want to embrace.
But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

partnerSkill.name: Hug Me Please
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack)

CactusDoll_Dark.name: Needoll Noct
CactusDoll_Dark.description:
Its spikes react to its emotions. 
A well-loved <characterName id=|CactusDoll_Dark|/> clings to its owner, 
but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

partnerSkill.name: Hug You So Much
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Ivy-Covered 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack)

IceDeer.name: Reindrix
IceDeer.description:
Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero.
Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen
and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Heat Resistance +2. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

GrassPanda.name: Mossanda
GrassPanda.description:
A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe.
In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once!
It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

GrassPanda_Electric.name: Mossanda Lux
GrassPanda_Electric.description:
A Pal whose power is truly shocking.
By altering the electrical currents in its body, 
this Pal's been able to overload its own strength.
When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

WeaselDragon.name: Chillet
WeaselDragon.description:
It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. 
Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated 
<characterName id=|WeaselDragon|/> as they grazed to produce butter 
using this spinning force.

partnerSkill.name: Wriggling Weasel
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dragon and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

WeaselDragon_Fire.name: Chillet Ignis
WeaselDragon_Fire.description:
It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. 
Sparks also fly when it feels excited. 
If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!

partnerSkill.name: Sparkling Weasel
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

RedArmorBird.name: Ragnahawk
RedArmorBird.description:
Some think it is a related species to <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>, but there is in fact no connection.
It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its
beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Wing
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

VolcanoDragon.name: Moldron
VolcanoDragon.description:
In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. 
However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, 
eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Overload
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal's Attack increases by 4/5/6/7/8% for each other Fire or Ground Pal in your party.

VolcanoDragon_Ice.name: Moldron Cryst
VolcanoDragon_Ice.description:
In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. 
However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, 
eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, 
abrupt death from shock.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Overload
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Ice damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

TropicalOstrich.name: Palumba
TropicalOstrich.description:
Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance.
In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses.
Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance!
Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

partnerSkill.name: Samba Step
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 155/175/195/215/240% while mounted on grass.

DrillGame.name: Digtoise
DrillGame.description:
A <characterName id=|DrillGame|/> possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it,
ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |<characterName id=|DrillGame|/>'s Fable|.

partnerSkill.name: Drill Crusher
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, enters the Shell Spin state. Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by 800/1000/1200/1500/2000%.

SakuraSaurus.name: Broncherry
SakuraSaurus.description:
Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing.
It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner,
which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|

partnerSkill.name: Love's First Blossom
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35/37/39/41/45% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

SakuraSaurus_Water.name: Broncherry Aqua
SakuraSaurus_Water.description:
Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing.
It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner,
which is called the |Perfume of Purity.|

partnerSkill.name: Purity's Full Bloom
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a 45/47/49/51/55% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

LazyCatfish.name: Dumud
LazyCatfish.description:
When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines.
Even if it were sliced from head to tail,
it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Ground Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.

LazyCatfish_Gold.name: Dumud Gild
LazyCatfish_Gold.description:
Its body reflects light with astounding clarity.
Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than <characterName id=|LazyCatfish|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Harvest
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +100/110/130/160/200%. Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack)

Plesiosaur.name: Braloha
Plesiosaur.description:
Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance 
that pollinates any plant it touches. 
For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

partnerSkill.name: Balmy Weather
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in your base, increases the egg production speed of Pals assigned to Breeding Farm by 20/26/32/38/50%. (Does not stack)

AmaterasuWolf.name: Kitsun
AmaterasuWolf.description:
Despite its appearance, <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf|/> is extremely sensitive and will flee 
into a cave when spooked.
Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

AmaterasuWolf_Dark.name: Kitsun Noct
AmaterasuWolf_Dark.description:
Despite its appearance, <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> is 
extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked.
It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.

partnerSkill.name: Gloomhowl
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Dark damage and are immune to Blind. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

Manticore.name: Blazehowl
Manticore.description:
While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat.
This is due to its blistering claws,
which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.

partnerSkill.name: Hellflame Lion
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Grass Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

Manticore_Dark.name: Blazehowl Noct
Manticore_Dark.description:
While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat.
This is due to its dark claws,
which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

partnerSkill.name: Darkflame Lion
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Neutral Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

HerculesBeetle.name: Warsect
HerculesBeetle.description:
The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is
extremely strong and heat resistant.
Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

partnerSkill.name: Cast-Iron Shell
partnerSkill.desc: While in your party, generates a barrier around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within 5/6/7/8/9 seconds. (Does not stack)

HerculesBeetle_Ground.name: Warsect Terra
HerculesBeetle_Ground.description:
The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is
extremely strong and heat resistant.
It doesn't flinch even if a <characterName id=|GrassMammoth|/> steps on it.

partnerSkill.name: Fullmetal Shell
partnerSkill.desc: While in your party, generates a barrier around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within 5/6/7/8/9 seconds. (Does not stack)

SnowPeafowl.name: Frostplume
SnowPeafowl.description:
So precise is its sense of time that 
it awakens at the exact same hour every morning.
According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because
when <characterName id=|SnowPeafowl|/> spreads its tail feathers wide,
it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

partnerSkill.name: Peacock Pounce
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, <characterName id=|SnowPeafowl|/>'s icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player's reload speeds by 20/26/32/38/50%. (Does not stack)

DarkFlameFox.name: Majex
DarkFlameFox.description:
It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply 
bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

partnerSkill.name: Phantasmal Arcana
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15/18/21/24/30% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

WhiteMoth.name: Sibelyx
WhiteMoth.description:
A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers
until the weather clears up.
On rainy days, <characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/> can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

partnerSkill.name: Silk Shroud
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Blizzard Spike. When this Pal uses Blizzard Spike, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier. Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

WhiteMoth_Neutral.name: Sibelyx Primo
WhiteMoth_Neutral.description:
A Pal that loves gazing into the void, 
and will often remain completely still. 
It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Gilded Shroud
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Neutral Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

GhostBeast.name: Maraith
GhostBeast.description:
It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death.
If a <characterName id=|GhostBeast|/> has taken a liking to you,
it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30/34/40/48/60% whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)

MushroomDragon.name: Shroomer
MushroomDragon.description:
Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance.
Sometimes, if <characterName id=|MushroomDragon|/> appears motionless,
it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom,
but rather because it's high off its own spores.

partnerSkill.name: Rampant Spores
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.

MushroomDragon_Dark.name: Shroomer Noct
MushroomDragon_Dark.description:
The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight.
Sometimes, if <characterName id=|MushroomDragon_Dark|/> appears motionless,
it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom,
but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

partnerSkill.name: Roiling Spores
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by 10/11.5/13/14/15%.

IceWitch.name: Icelyn
IceWitch.description:
Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing.
Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much.
If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath 
under a clear blue sky.

partnerSkill.name: Witch's Icy Veil
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|IceWitch|/> changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

MummyPal.name: Gildra
MummyPal.description:
The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic.
However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, 
so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

partnerSkill.name: Resurrection
partnerSkill.desc: While fighting together, when <characterName id=|MummyPal|/> is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

Umihebi.name: Jormuntide
Umihebi.description:
Legend says the <characterName id=|Umihebi|/> was once a wise man who,
after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool,
