returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Sea Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Soak by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

Umihebi_Fire.name: Jormuntide Ignis
Umihebi_Fire.description:
Legend says the <characterName id=|Umihebi_Fire|/> was once a warrior who,
after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano,
returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Lava Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, nullifies lava damage and increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Burn by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

Suzaku.name: Suzaku
Suzaku.description:
It was once believed to usher in the dry season.
Whenever there was a drought the previous year, 
people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers,
hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Flame
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|Suzaku|/>)

Suzaku_Water.name: Suzaku Aqua
Suzaku_Water.description:
It was once believed to usher in the rainy season.
Whenever there was a flood the previous year, 
people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers,
hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Water
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|Suzaku_Water|/>)

FeatherOstrich.name: Dazemu
FeatherOstrich.description:
Take one step forward and forget your doubts.
Take two steps forward and forget your worries.
Take three steps forward and forget your fears.
Face any enemy.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Sprint
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 50/62/74/86/100% while mounted on sand.

SkyDragon.name: Quivern
SkyDragon.description:
Sleeping while cuddling a <characterName id=|SkyDragon|/> is said to be a heavenly experience,
but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones
that toss and turn in their sleep.

partnerSkill.name: Sky Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases Attack of Dragon Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

SkyDragon_Grass.name: Quivern Botan
SkyDragon_Grass.description:
When you hug <characterName id=|SkyDragon_Grass|/>,
if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny.
If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Grass and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

LeafPrincess.name: Lullu
LeafPrincess.description:
In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island.
<characterName id=|FlowerRabbit|/>'s hay fever is <characterName id=|LeafPrincess|/>'s fault.

partnerSkill.name: Floral Boost
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, <characterName id=|LeafPrincess|/> fills farms with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops by 50/55/60/65/70%.

SmallArmadillo.name: Kikit
SmallArmadillo.description:
A decade ago, <characterName id=|SmallArmadillo|/> soccer was popular. 
However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from 
the Free Pal Alliance. 
Nevertheless, the <characterName id=|SmallArmadillo|/>'s themselves didn't mind 
because it helped shed their old carapace.

partnerSkill.name: Sandball Soccer
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Ground Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

GuardianDog.name: Yakumo
GuardianDog.description:
It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil.
In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders.
Nowadays, <characterName id=|GuardianDog|/>s are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

partnerSkill.name: Birds of a Feather
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, 15/18/21/24/30% increased chance of encountering pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)

SwordCutlassfish.name: Skutlass
SwordCutlassfish.description:
A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body 
and uses its bones to slice through enemies, 
at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long.

While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated 
in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|SwordCutlassfish|/> becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2600/2700/3000/3400/3900). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, <characterName id=|SwordCutlassfish|/> will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

SwordCutlassfish_Fire.name: Skutlass Ignis
SwordCutlassfish_Fire.description:
A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long.

While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Seared Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|SwordCutlassfish_Fire|/> becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2900/3000/3300/3700/4200). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, <characterName id=|SwordCutlassfish_Fire|/> will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

VolcanicMonster.name: Reptyro
VolcanicMonster.description:
Magma-like blood runs throughout its body.
If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats,
causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ore-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore by 30/35/40/50/60%. (Does not stack)

VolcanicMonster_Ice.name: Reptyro Cryst
VolcanicMonster_Ice.description:
Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. 
If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, 
causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ice-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore by 35/40/45/55/65%. (Does not stack)

NightBlueHorse.name: Starryon
NightBlueHorse.description:
It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane.
If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. 
Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> at all costs.

partnerSkill.name: Night Dancer
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Boosts jumping ability while mounted. This Pal's movement speed increases by +50/62/74/86/100% at night.

NightBlueHorse_Neutral.name: Starryon Primo
NightBlueHorse_Neutral.description:
It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane.
If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified 
it can't focus on running properly. 
Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much,
even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

partnerSkill.name: Light Dancer
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|NightBlueHorse_Neutral|/>)

RockBeast.name: Pierdon
RockBeast.description:
It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape.
Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

partnerSkill.name: Power Stone
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack)

RockBeast_Ice.name: Pierdon Cryst
RockBeast_Ice.description:
It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape.
Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

partnerSkill.name: Power Crystal
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Dragon damage. (Does not stack)

WhiteTiger.name: Cryolinx
WhiteTiger.description:
It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws.
However, its short legs make it difficult to descend,
often leaving it stranded in high places.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Hunter
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, Dragon Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

WhiteTiger_Ground.name: Cryolinx Terra
WhiteTiger_Ground.description:
It can easily carry many items with its large hands. 
However, its short legs slow its pace, 
often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

partnerSkill.name: Explosive Strength
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when attacking enemy weak point, increases the power of the next weak point attack by 30/34/40/48/60%. (Does not stack)

SmallYeti.name: Snugloo
SmallYeti.description:
“To look at a <characterName id=|SmallYeti|/>'s eyes” 
is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. 
Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed 
whether <characterName id=|SmallYeti|/>s have eyes in the first place.

partnerSkill.name: Invisible Eye
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack) (Stealth Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

Yeti.name: Wumpo
Yeti.description:
Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form.
In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Transporting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

Yeti_Grass.name: Wumpo Botan
Yeti_Grass.description:
Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. 
In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the South
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Ground damage and are immune to Muddy status. (Does not stack)

CandleGhost.name: Sootseer
CandleGhost.description:
It was once believed that as the world approached its end, 
the flame would weaken.
Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken,
but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by <characterName id=|CandleGhost|/>.
At least, for now.

partnerSkill.name: Grave Robber
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Neutral damage. (Does not stack) Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.

VenusFlytrap.name: Carnibora
VenusFlytrap.description:
Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. 
However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

partnerSkill.name: Entangling Tongue
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, <characterName id=|VenusFlytrap|/> creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Grass / Power: 40/50/60/70/80). (Does not stack)

KingBahamut.name: Blazamut
KingBahamut.description:
Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption.
A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon
the back of a giant <characterName id=|KingBahamut|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Kaiser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 5/6/7/8/10% whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.

KingBahamut_Dragon.name: Blazamut Ryu
KingBahamut_Dragon.description:
Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth.
With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy,
it burned the entire island until nothing remained.
It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Dragon damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

GrassGolem.name: Dualith
GrassGolem.description:
One entity, two minds.
When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

partnerSkill.name: Forest Laser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. When activated, <characterName id=|GrassGolem|/> fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

GrassGolem_Dark.name: Dualith Noct
GrassGolem_Dark.description:
One entity, two minds.
They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

partnerSkill.name: Corruption Laser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. When activated, <characterName id=|GrassGolem_Dark|/> fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

Anubis.name: Anubis
Anubis.description:
Once seen as a symbol of nobility, 
and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power.
Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Desert
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|Anubis|/> changes the player's attack type to Ground and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%. Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle.

Sekhmet.name: Sekhmet
Sekhmet.description:
Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death.
When <characterName id=|Anubis|/> claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine.
Before long, <characterName id=|Sekhmet|/> became a symbol of high nobility.

partnerSkill.name: Desert Empress
partnerSkill.desc: While at base, boosts <characterName id=|Anubis|/>'s work speed by 20/24/28/32/40%. Increases efficiency by 30/36/42/48/60% if <characterName id=|Sekhmet|/> is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

ScorpionMan.name: Prixter
ScorpionMan.description:
It has about 5,000 types of venom.
Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death,
but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.

partnerSkill.name: Phantom Venom
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack)

ScorpionMan_Electric.name: Prixter Lux
ScorpionMan_Electric.description:
It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. 
However, the current it generates is extremely weak,
so a simple punch would do far more damage.

partnerSkill.name: Scorpion Longwave
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|ScorpionMan_Electric|/> changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

CubeTurtle.name: Tetroise
CubeTurtle.description:
Those stones on its back are not just cargo. 
Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

partnerSkill.name: Masonry Archelon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

CubeTurtle_Neutral.name: Tetroise Primo
CubeTurtle_Neutral.description:
Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, 
<characterName id=|CubeTurtle_Neutral|/> will know where they are. 
No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.

partnerSkill.name: Stone-Chaser Archelon
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the durability of all weapons and armor by 80/84/88/92/100%. (Does not stack)

BadCatgirl.name: Nyafia
BadCatgirl.description:
Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. 
If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears
and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|BadCatgirl|/> will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time. While in party, increases the player's shotgun damage by 10/15/20/25/35%. (Does not stack)

MimicDog.name: Mimog
MimicDog.description:
There was once a tradition of handing out an award
to the person who met their end in the most foolish way.
The first award was given for
|being unaware of <characterName id=|MimicDog|/>, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|

partnerSkill.name: Master of Unlocking
partnerSkill.desc: While fighting together, <characterName id=|MimicDog|/> can open treasure chests without using a key. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

DarkAlien.name: Xenovader
DarkAlien.description:
Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it.
Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Invader
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by 100/110/120/135/160%. (Does not stack)

WhiteAlienDragon.name: Xenogard
WhiteAlienDragon.description:
Consumes information and turns it into energy.
Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Intruder
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by 10/15/20/25/35%. (Does not stack)

BlueberryFairy.name: Prunelia
BlueberryFairy.description:
Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, 
it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles.
However, when encountered at night, 
its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, <characterName id=|BlueberryFairy|/>'s prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by 18/22/26/30/35%.

GhostRabbit.name: Nitemary
GhostRabbit.description:
What it carries is its own soul. 
When it falls for someone, 
it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, 
yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Collector
partnerSkill.desc: While fighting together, Pals drop +100/110/130/160/200% more Pal Souls when defeated. (Does not stack)

GhostRabbit_Grass.name: Nitemary Botan
GhostRabbit_Grass.description:
What it carries is its own soul. 
When it falls for someone, 
it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs,
yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Binder
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Grass Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

BlackPuppy.name: Smokie
BlackPuppy.description:
The black flames are merely warm to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. 
Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Smokie! Dig!
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, Chromite acquisition increases by +100/110/130/160/200%.

BlackPuppy_Ice.name: Smokie Cryst
BlackPuppy_Ice.description:
The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes.
Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

partnerSkill.name: Cryo Instincts
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

MysteryMask.name: Omascul
MysteryMask.description:
The mask it wears is not its face, they say.
It seems in front, but it's not there, no way.
From shadows deep, it watches night and day.
Glance away, and closer it will stray.

partnerSkill.name: Masquerade Dance
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Party Pals' EXP gained by 40/44/52/64/80%. (Does not stack)

IceNarwhal.name: Whalaska
IceNarwhal.description:
When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. 
Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, 
it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

partnerSkill.name: Chilled Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by 5/7/9/11/14%. Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by 5/7/9/11/14%. (Does not stack) (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

IceNarwhal_Fire.name: Whalaska Ignis
IceNarwhal_Fire.description:
Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, 
it turned bright red through sheer will.
Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red.
So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

partnerSkill.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge 7/9/11/13/17% higher than usual, and capture progress increases by 7/9/11/13/17% while the bars overlap. (Does not stack) (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

GrassRabbitMan.name: Verdash
GrassRabbitMan.description:
Land that <characterName id=|GrassRabbitMan|/> has run across becomes extremely fertile,
with thick vegetation growing soon after.
It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

partnerSkill.name: Grassland Gymnast
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, grants 1 additional jump and 1 additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack)

GrimGirl.name: Splatterina
GrimGirl.description:
It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart.
Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment.
If caught by <characterName id=|GrimGirl|/>, pray that your head is taken first.

partnerSkill.name: Blade of Uncontrolled Passion
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by 100/110/130/160/200%. (Does not stack)

GoldenHorse.name: Gildane
GoldenHorse.description:
During the golden age of alchemy on the island, 
its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold.
In time, a remarkable revelation was made: 
the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

partnerSkill.name: Sandstorm's Blessing
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ground and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

SifuDog.name: Dogen
SifuDog.description:
Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. 
After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects.
It ate too much today.

partnerSkill.name: Homeward Prayer
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

SumoDog.name: Bulldosu
SumoDog.description:
In the old islands, <characterName id=|SumoDog|/> sumo was widely enjoyed.
At the highest levels, even a charging <characterName id=|Boar|/> would be sent flying instead.

partnerSkill.name: Yokozuna's Presence
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)

WhiteDeer.name: Celesdir
WhiteDeer.description:
Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| 
The light emitted by <characterName id=|WhiteDeer|/> purifies everything,
literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Purification
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by 2/3/4/5/6% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.15/0.23/0.3/0.45/0.75% per second. (Does not stack)

WhiteDeer_Dark.name: Celesdir Noct
WhiteDeer_Dark.description:
Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born.
It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be.
Balance is what the world requires.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Chaos
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for 40/50/60/70/80% Attack increase. (Does not stack)

BlackMetalDragon.name: Astegon
BlackMetalDragon.description:
A savage beast born of the abyss. 
Thou shall not stand before the beast. 
Thou shall not heed the beast.

partnerSkill.name: Black Ankylosaur
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores by 1100/1500/2000/2600/3300%, and you can obtain 150/180/210/240/300% more Ore while mounted.

WingGolem.name: Knocklem
WingGolem.description:
Can be disassembled into 215 parts. 
It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again 
even if the parts are scattered.
Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger 
a malfunction due to mistaken identity.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases <characterName id=|WingGolem|/>'s Attack by 50/75/110/150/200% and Defense by 50/75/110/150/200% for a limited time.

WingGolem_Fire.name: Knocklem Ignis
WingGolem_Fire.description:
Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. 
Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger 
a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.

partnerSkill.name: Iron Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases <characterName id=|WingGolem_Fire|/>'s Attack by 60/85/120/160/210% and Defense by 60/85/120/160/210% for a limited time.

WhiteShieldDragon.name: Silvegis
WhiteShieldDragon.description:
The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties.
If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it.
When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, 
and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

partnerSkill.name: Aegis Shield
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay by 30/34/40/48/60% and reduces damage taken by your shield by 65/68/71/75/80%. (Does not stack)

BlueThunderHorse.name: Azurmane
BlueThunderHorse.description:
Like <characterName id=|Kirin|/>, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. 
As faith in <characterName id=|Kirin|/> waned, <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> was deemed the God's true envoy.
Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

partnerSkill.name: Plasma Dash
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Grants Air Dash, to move at even higher speeds. (Dash Speed Up + Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

LongCat.name: Valentail
LongCat.description:
In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today.
For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to 
elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly 
ten times its current size within the next century.

partnerSkill.name: Big Stretch
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack)

ElecSnail.name: Snock
ElecSnail.description:
Tossing an <characterName id=|ElecSnail|/> into the bath for a shock spa 
is considered a traditional health practice.
That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

partnerSkill.name: Charging Shell
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack)

ElecSnail_Ground.name: Snock Lux
ElecSnail_Ground.description:
Tossing a heated <characterName id=|ElecSnail_Ground|/> into the bath for a scorching spa 
was once a fad of the distant past.
Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

partnerSkill.name: Grounding Shell
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack)

DandelionGirl.name: Souffline
DandelionGirl.description:
Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories.
Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

partnerSkill.name: Fuzzy Fairy
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack) (Capture Rate Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

BrownRabbit.name: Lapiron
BrownRabbit.description:
Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease.
However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's Defense by 50/52/55/59/65% while sprinting. (Does not stack)

HoodGhost.name: Hoodle
HoodGhost.description:
When it sleeps, it deflates.
When it sleeps, it's no longer there.
A sleeping <characterName id=|HoodGhost|/> cannot exist;
Therefore, <characterName id=|HoodGhost|/> never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by 50/60/70/80/100%. (Does not stack)

ElecLizard.name: Slowatt
ElecLizard.description:
Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like.
Surely, <characterName id=|ElecLizard|/> must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury.
...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to 40/44/48/52/60% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

OniGhostGirl.name: Bakemi
OniGhostGirl.description:
It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening.
As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness,
<characterName id=|OniGhostGirl|/> now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

partnerSkill.name: Grinning Death
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack by 40/50/60/70/80%. (Does not stack)

KingSunfish.name: Solmora
KingSunfish.description:
Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. 
Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, 
it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Fish
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack) (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

KingSunfish_Thunder.name: Solmora Lux
KingSunfish_Thunder.description:
Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. 
Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, 
it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.

partnerSkill.name: Shocking Fish
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack) (Swim Speed Up: -/10%/14%/18%/25%)

SleeveRabbit.name: Lapure
SleeveRabbit.description:
It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, 
always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained.
Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, 
kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

partnerSkill.name: Long-Sleeved Hurray
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals by 10/15/20/30/50%. (Does not stack)

GhostDragon.name: Eidrolon
GhostDragon.description:
A new Pal that was only recently discovered.
Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. 
It is no longer bound by anything.

partnerSkill.name: Liberated Pterosaur
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by 2/3/4/5/6% for each other Dragonor Dark Pal in your party.

GhostDragon_Fire.name: Eidrolon Ignis
GhostDragon_Fire.description:
A new Pal that was only recently discovered.
It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature 
leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.

partnerSkill.name: Resentful Pterosaur
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by 2/3/4/5/6% or each other Dragon or Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding <characterName id=|GhostDragon_Fire|/>)

ThunderFluffyBird.name: Dynamoff
ThunderFluffyBird.description:
With so little to eat at high altitudes, 
it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains.
It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source 
descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>.

partnerSkill.name: Electro-Massage Incubation
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs by 20/22/26/32/40%. (Does not stack)

RedFlowerBird.name: Tropicaw
RedFlowerBird.description:
While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers 
swaying in the wind and avoid predators, 
others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

partnerSkill.name: Flower Dance
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by 15/20/23/27/30%. (Does not stack)

FoxExorcist.name: Flaracle
FoxExorcist.description:
It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames.
Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result.
That is why the future of <characterName id=|FoxExorcist|/> is always exceptionally bright!

partnerSkill.name: Burning Future
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to 40/44/48/52/60% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

LotusDragon.name: Ophydia
LotusDragon.description:
Waters where <characterName id=|LotusDragon|/>s dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. 
Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, 
but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

partnerSkill.name: Glorious Mist
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Soak 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack)

ClownRabbit.name: Dupin
ClownRabbit.description:
A copy it created might quietly replace it, 
leaving even the <characterName id=|ClownRabbit|/> itself unsure whether it is still the original.

partnerSkill.name: Trick-Loving Fluffle
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, <characterName id=|ClownRabbit|/> generates an explosion around the player (Fire / Power: 100/110/130/160/200 / Burn buildup: 777). Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased by 30/35/40/45/50%. (Does not stack)

ThiefBird.name: Roujay
ThiefBird.description:
A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking.
No reason to be concerned when caught in the act.
Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

partnerSkill.name: Dark-Nester
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind by 50/53/56/60/65%. (Does not stack)

SnakeGirl.name: Venusa
SnakeGirl.description:
Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head.
However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

partnerSkill.name: Snake's Sagacity
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Blind 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack)

MushroomLady.name: Mycora
MushroomLady.description:
It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts.
The reason <characterName id=|MushroomLady|/> has taken this form is to deceive humans 
into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Spore
partnerSkill.desc: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

LanternButler.name: Loomen
LanternButler.description:
Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world.
If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

partnerSkill.name: Lantern Enchantment
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to 15/18/21/25/30% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

MoonChild.name: Wistella
MoonChild.description:
At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, 
glowing with the weight of its memories.

partnerSkill.name: Hidden Dark Energy
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Dark Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

MonochromeQueen.name: Solenne
MonochromeQueen.description:
Joy and misery come in equal measure for <characterName id=|MonochromeQueen|/>. 
Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

partnerSkill.name: Untainted Maiden
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases the player's Attack by 30/40/50/60/80% if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack)

KabukiMan.name: Renjishi
KabukiMan.description:
At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings.
Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, 
and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.

partnerSkill.name: Stage Combat
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Burn 2/3/4/5/6. (Does not stack)

DomeArmorDragon.name: Aegidron
DomeArmorDragon.description:
In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, 
the light within <characterName id=|DomeArmorDragon|/>'s wings was used to send simple flash signals.

partnerSkill.name: Indestructible Fortress
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 60/65/70/75/80% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)

ElecPanda.name: Grizzbolt
ElecPanda.description:
With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, 
it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner.
For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change 
when wielding a minigun.

partnerSkill.name: Yellow Tank
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

LilyQueen.name: Lyleen
LilyQueen.description:
A docile Pal full of love. 
It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. 
It uses a full-power <activeSkillName id=|SolarBeam|/> to discipline naughty Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Harvest Goddess
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 80/82/84/86/90%.

LilyQueen_Dark.name: Lyleen Noct
LilyQueen_Dark.description:
An elegant Pal full of grace. 
It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. 
Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

partnerSkill.name: Goddess of the Tranquil Light
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 85/87/89/91/95%.

ThunderDragonMan.name: Orserk
ThunderDragonMan.description:
It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. 
Fights between <characterName id=|ThunderDragonMan|/> end in the blink of an eye.

partnerSkill.name: Ferocious Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 1/2/3/4/5% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

Horus.name: Faleris
Horus.description:
When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, 
burning the entire area to ash.
<characterName id=|Horus|/> breath is known for its pleasing scent.

partnerSkill.name: Scorching Predator
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Ice Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

Horus_Water.name: Faleris Aqua
Horus_Water.description:
When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area.
More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, 
leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

partnerSkill.name: Tidal Predator
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Fire Pals drop 40/50/60/70/80% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

BlackGriffon.name: Shadowbeak
BlackGriffon.description:
Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason.
Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals,
one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Modified DNA
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by 15/17/20/24/30% while mounted.

MoonQueen.name: Selyne
MoonQueen.description:
The object floating behind, resembling the moon,
is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation.
No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

partnerSkill.name: Celestial Darkness
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, enhances Neutral and Dark attacks by 15/17/20/24/30%.

SnowTigerBeastman.name: Bastigor
SnowTigerBeastman.description:
The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it.
For <characterName id=|SnowTigerBeastMan|/> the toughest challenge, after simply living,
is making a snowman.

partnerSkill.name: Blizzard Crash
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

BlueSkyDragon.name: Shaolong
BlueSkyDragon.description:
Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, 
the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

partnerSkill.name: Azure Sovereign
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by 4/5/6/7/8% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.

Mothman.name: Silvance
Mothman.description:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|Mothman|/> does not know.
After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. 
The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

partnerSkill.name: Spore Stalwart
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to 40/44/48/52/60% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores to both the player and their Pals.

FlowerPrince.name: Dandilord
FlowerPrince.description:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|FlowerPrince|/> does not care.
After all, the World Tree knows everything.
Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

partnerSkill.name: Mist Stalwart
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, the player's attacks inflict Poison 2/3/4/5/6. While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

NightLady.name: Bellanoir
NightLady.description:
Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world.
One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen.
With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality,
thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Iris
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Ray. When this Pal uses Nightmare Ray, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier.

NightLady_Dark.name: Bellanoir Libero
NightLady_Dark.description:
With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed.
She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. 
And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, 
were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Stare
partnerSkill.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Bloom. When this Pal uses Nightmare Bloom, it has a x1.1/1.3/1.6/2/2.5 damage multiplier.

DarkMechaDragon.name: Xenolord
DarkMechaDragon.description:
-Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon|
-Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by <://Error_Code:126DC> years.
-Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol.
-Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Wings
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by 20/26/32/38/50%. (Does not stack) (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

LegendDeer.name: Hartalis
LegendDeer.description:
The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing.
No one else remains. All have been delivered.
O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness.
-The ancient text cuts off here.

partnerSkill.name: Sacred Barrier
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, it generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted. (Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

SaintCentaur.name: Paladius
SaintCentaur.description:
Once one with <characterName id=|BlackCentaur|/>.
Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions.
However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Holy Knight of the Firmament
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted. Activate Spear Thrust to have <characterName id=|BlackCentaur|/> stay by your side and attack enemies in tandem. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

BlackCentaur.name: Necromus
BlackCentaur.description:
Once one with <characterName id=|SaintCentaur|/>. 
Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. 
However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knight of the Abyss
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. When Twin Spears skill is activated, a <characterName id=|SaintCentaur|/> in your party will appear and attack alongside you. (Ride Speed Up: -/10%/12%/15%/20%)

IceHorse.name: Frostallion
IceHorse.description:
Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller.
In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky
and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Steed
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice, inflict Freeze 2/3/4/5/6, increases Attack by 10/14/20/28/40%.

IceHorse_Dark.name: Frostallion Noct
IceHorse_Dark.description:
Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller.
In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky
and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Steed
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark, inflict Blind 2/3/4/5/6, increases Attack by 10/14/20/28/40%.

PoseidonOrca.name: Neptilius
PoseidonOrca.description:
After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. 
It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. 
For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

partnerSkill.name: Sentinel of the Great Sea
partnerSkill.desc: While in party, it follows up the player's attacks with Water spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water. (Swim Speed Up -/10%/14%/18%/25% + Cooldown Reduction: -/S/M/L/XL)

JetDragon.name: Jetragon
JetDragon.description:
Watches over Palpagos Island from high above.
When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, 
and the skies will burn.
It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Missile
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

KingWhale.name: Panthalus
KingWhale.description:
The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart.
Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, 
its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

WorldTreeDragon.name: Astralym
WorldTreeDragon.description:
A shadow of its former self, 
this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago.
Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia 
until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer

partnerSkill.desc: This Pal's abilities are still being investigated.

YakushimaMonster001.name: Green Slime
YakushimaMonster001.description:
[Tides of Terraria] 
A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

partnerSkill.name: Slime Body
partnerSkill.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaBoss001.description:

partnerSkill.desc: When activated, <characterName id=|YakushimaBoss001|/> charges and attacks targeted enemy. (Damage Up: -/S/M/L/XL)

YakushimaBoss001_Small.description:

partnerSkill.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)
